resources.string:
Cliorius Launcher is a fork of Pojav Glow·Worm (by Vera-Firefly), which is based on PojavLauncher —
 a Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android devices.
 Developed by dravwho. Forked from Pojav Glow·Worm with a redesigned interface and performance features.
 
 Cliorius Launcher is licensed under the GPLv3 open source license (inherited from Pojav).
 Any project that uses, modifies, or derives from this software must also be open sourced under the GPL license.
 If you distribute or share this software, please comply with the GPLv3 license requirements.

 Thanks to MCHeads for providing Minecraft avatars.
